text.text_excerpt: Nice new mexican option in an area that really needed it. I was craving guacamole, and I'd usually make it, but avocados in 3 stores I tried weren't ripe. Being a Wednesday, all Juan's locations were closed. What to do? I consulted my handy dandy Yelp! app and found this gem. I called in an order of cheese Chile Relleno and guacamole and chips (of course). The Relleno came as a meal, with black beans, yellow rice, flour tortillas, and a salad. Every component was flavorful and perfectly made. The star though was the Guac- I saved some for today and will definitely go back for more. The meal-sharing board was a great community touch. Please patronize this new business and show your support!

A must if you want authentic and super fresh Mexican food! I ordered the grilled snapper tacos with black beans and rice with an appetizer of guacamole. I wasn't used to chunkier guacamole but was so pleasantly surprised and their tacos were outstanding. I don't typically eat Mexican rice but found myself finishing the entire serving and the tortillas tasted like they were hand prepared. 10/10!

Pretty cool place. Fairly new. Some nice decorations. There are some parking spots in front as well as street parking. It was fairly empty when I went. Staff was friendly. Gave us complimentary chips and salsa. They recommended the tamarind drink which was fantastic. tried the tacos and Birria. It was all great! Staff was attentive too. Would highly recommend!
